title: Volkara's Bite
summary: Volkara drops egg sacs at health thresholds that soon hatch into spiderlings.
overview: Volkara drops egg sacs at health thresholds that soon hatch into spiderlings.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: At 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% and 10%, expect a new egg sequence.
Deal with egg sacs before their thirty-second hatch timer when possible.
Keep an add tank ready for magma spiderlings and avoid pushing several thresholds together.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 9.
